title: Choose the visual world for reviewrelay.dev
question: The roll assigned Crash Test Rating Sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Crash Test Rating Sheet
options.lineage: Euro NCAP / IIHS rating sheets and crash-hall test photography
options.thesis: Every pull request goes through the test hall before it merges; the rating sheet is the verdict.
materials: high-speed film frames with ms timecodes
options.viewport: The page is the rating sheet: the PR as test specimen, a monumental overall score with six category bars, a timecoded frame strip from review started to comment landed, and the install command as the test-bay start line.
options.risk: Car-safety borrowing can read as costume, and 'crash' implies failure, so ratings must read as verdicts, not wrecks.

raised.raise: Each configured agent keeps one persistent lane mark across the sheet, so independent reviewers read as independent test runs.
Step numerals at monumental scale, and every element snaps to one module grid.
Each stage of a run is stamped with its elapsed time and marked as irreversible past the line.
The high-speed frame strip is built as real scroll-driven motion, not a static picture of film.
Test yellow and hall white own whole regions; no neutral template ground anywhere.

options.label: Judges' Panel
options.lineage: diving and gymnastics judging boards, broadcast score graphics
options.thesis: Several judges score the same routine; the board shows every card and circles the one that counts.
options.viewport: A row of judges' cards raised over the PR, the lowest circled as the headline, the install command riding the lower-third bar.
options.risk: The most familiar metaphor for 'several scores'; sports broadcast styling can tip into gimmick.

options.label: Terminal Yellow Wayfinding
options.thesis: The page is a concourse of decision points: a trigger fires, agents run, the comment arrives at its gate.
options.viewport: One overhead yellow band reading PR #482 to review, three agents, with the install command signed as the next decision.
options.case: Fuses well: trigger modes map to junctions. Loses on clarity because scoring has no native home in wayfinding.
options.risk: Yellow-band signage is a widely borrowed look, and the score could feel bolted on.

options.label: Brick Build Instructions
options.thesis: Setup as numbered exploded steps on sky-blue pages.
options.viewport: Numbered install spreads with 1:1 command call-outs.
options.case: Setup fuses well, but the scored review has no native form, and it reads too playful for this audience.
options.kept: Monumental step numerals on one module grid.
options.risk: Toy register undercuts a precision tool.

options.label: Darkroom Safelight
options.thesis: The review develops like a print in timed baths.
options.viewport: A tray where the scored comment emerges.
options.case: Its amber-on-dark ground lands near the dark-glow look you ruled out, and development fits waiting, not scoring.
options.kept: Timestamped stations, irreversible past a marked line.

options.label: Sleeping City Fold
options.thesis: Repos as districts dreaming under one night.
options.viewport: A folded night city of watched repos.
options.case: A dreamlike metaphor obscures a precise tool; terminal users do not identify with it.
options.kept: Each independent district keeps its own persistent identity.

options.label: WebGL Shader Portal
options.thesis: A living shader field with thin type floating over it.
options.viewport: A full-bleed shader with one hero word.
options.case: A dark ground with one incandescent accent is exactly the look the brief excluded.
options.kept: Build the named technique for real.

options.label: Lowbrow Gallery Panel
options.thesis: Agents as lacquered monsters crowding one panel.
options.viewport: A packed airbrushed tableau with a lettered title.
options.case: Too playful and illustrated for terminal users, as the brief warned.
options.kept: No unpainted area: total material coverage.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dev-tool landing page, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Centered headline, install command, a terminal screenshot, then a three-feature grid.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
